papers.title: Self-Supervised Visual On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract: Visual on-policy distillation achieves learning signals through asymmetric augmented views. The method improves Qwen3.5-4B from 70.7% to 77.4% across fine-grained perception benchmarks without privileged annotations or larger teachers.

papers.title: Apodex Discovery: Reality Benchmarks and Environments for Evaluating and Building Discoverative Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: A framework for verifiable AI investigations using a heavy-duty solver across real-world scientific tasks. The system integrates foundation models, tools, and control policies for extended stateful research with intermediate artifact verification.

papers.title: SimpleOPD: Simple Tokenizer-Agnostic On-Policy Distillation for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation transfers proof-reasoning from long-context teachers to short-context students by handling tokenizer differences and constraining length growth. Intern-S2-Preview improves by 21.2 points on ProofBench, reaching 55.2.

papers.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
papers.abstract: A 1-billion-parameter Hierarchical Reasoning Model trained solely on permissible data achieves competitive English performance and state-of-the-art Danish results across 20 benchmarks, demonstrating ethical data sourcing viability.

papers.title: Modular Cognitive Architecture Emerges in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Circuit analyses across 46 tasks reveal that LLMs develop modular architectures mirroring human brain specialization across language, formal reasoning, social reasoning, and physical reasoning domains.

papers.title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
papers.abstract: A toolkit enabling fine-grained robotic evaluation through dense progress curves and multiple metrics characterizing failure recovery, execution quality, and success-side performance beyond binary outcome measures.

papers.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: An approach making privileged teaching context learnable end-to-end from experience. The method provides dense token-level supervision and demonstrates strong performance with less than 30% of rollout budget compared to alternatives.

papers.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
papers.abstract: A training-free framework running auxiliary reasoning branches in parallel during agent action-observation waits, reducing sequential decoding by up to 43% and lowering turn counts without significant accuracy degradation.

papers.title: Forecast Collapse in Time-Series Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Identifies forecast collapse in equity return predictions due to low predictability and per-series objectives. The proposed CalibRank objective nearly triples cross-sectional correlation while maintaining amplitude calibration.

papers.title: LittleLearner: Language Models Under Pedagogically Controlled Knowledge Exposure
papers.abstract: A 5B-parameter model trained on an 88B-token elementary-grade corpus creates a controlled sandbox for studying knowledge acquisition with clear capability boundaries mapped to curriculum guidelines.

cc_updates.body: Added the optional `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory. Added the `selection:clear` keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view. Added a GitLab merge request badge to the footer and statusline: repos with a GitLab remote and an authenticated glab CLI show MR !N with draft/pending/green states. Claude Code now continues your session automatically when a claude.ai usage limit resets; turn it off in `/config` ("Continue automatically at usage limit"). Claude is now told to use your account email only to identify you, and not to send it to unrelated services unless you ask. Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (`\??\`) paths, hardening the remaining pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector.

Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`). Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user. Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session. Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes). Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt. Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts).

Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default. Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly. `SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first. Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you. Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse). Added secret redaction for GitLab token families and full redaction of routable tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`. Added GitLab support to plugin marketplaces: bare `gitlab.com` repo URLs now clone like `github.com` URLs.
